programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Richard forgets his wedding anniversary but then tells Hyacinth that he had a new alarm installed as an anniversary present, only he has forgotten the code.

programme.title: Bookmark
programme.desc: After a 14 year dry spell, novelist, Barbara Pym is nominated for a Booker Prize in 1977 for her novel `Quartet in Autumn'. A look at the day of the prize presentation, as she observes people and reminisces about life and love.

programme.title: Imagine...
programme.desc: Romantic, fearless, fantastical: delve into the thrilling world of Philip Pullman, and explore the author's own dark materials. Philip has been named both one of Britain's greatest writers and the most dangerous writer in Britain. He is best known for the much-loved `His Dark Materials' trilogy, which follows a young heroine, Lyra, through a series of heart-stopping adventures into other worlds.

programme.title: A Garden in Snowdonia
programme.desc: Head gardener Troy Scott Smith and his team give Bodnant a facelift, supervisor Adam Salvin brings a beautiful terrace back to its former glory, Dave Larter shares his passion for giant lilies, and the world famous Laburnum Arch is in full bloom.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Narrowboater Robbie Cumming begins his 170-mile journey across the north of England and soon runs into difficulty when he encounters a propeller problem in Wigan and runs aground in Blackburn. Nevertheless, he pushes on to navigate a true wonder of the waterways: the Burnley Embankment.

programme.title: Archaeology: A Secret History
programme.desc: Archaeologist Richard Miles shows how discoveries in the 18th and 19th centuries overturned ideas of when and where civilisation began, as empires competed to `own' the past.

programme.title: Thatcher: A Very British Revolution
programme.desc: As Mrs Thatcher's government transforms the British economy, tensions erupt within her inner circle and relationships in her own family are exposed. Mrs Thatcher's forthright style has led to her being viewed as domineering and unsympathetic.

programme.title: Margaret
programme.desc: On 12th November 1990, Thatcher is preparing for her speech at the Lord Mayor's banquet at the Guildhall, while Geoffrey Howe, her quietly-spoken former foreign secretary and chancellor, is penning the resignation speech that was to stun the country and seal her fate. The next day, Howe makes his lethal speech in the Houses of Parliament and the final ten days of Margaret Thatcher's reign begin.

programme.title: How to Get Ahead
programme.desc: Stephen Smith explores the flamboyant Baroque court of the Sun King, Louis XIV. Louis created the Palace of Versailles so he could surround himself with aristocrats, artists, interior designers, gardeners, wigmakers, chefs and musicians. Hordes of ambitious courtiers scrambled to get close to the king, but unseemly goings-on in the royal bedchamber reflected the quickest path to power.

programme.title: Channel Off Air
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae Harmoni, Melodi a Bop yn mynd i ganol y coed a'r planhigion yn y jwngl. Mae'r Tralalas yn cael hwyl yn siglo ar y coed! The crew go to the jungle to marvel at trees and plants galore.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae'n ddiwrnod cyntaf yr haf ac mae pawb yn edrych ymlaen at ddathlu. It's the first day of summer and everyone's looking forward to the celebration party.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Dewch ar daith o gwmpas y byd! Beth am deithio i'r ynys werdd, sef Iwerddon? A visit to both the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland to learn more about the cultures.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae hoff degan Twm wedi torri... felly mae Doctor Mai-Mai yn addo ei drwsio. On a poptastic adventure, Plom's favourite toy is broken, so Doctor Mai-Mai promises to fix it.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Megan yn mynd ar antur i weld o ble mae'r dwr sy'n cyrraedd y ty yn dod a sut mae'n cael ei lanhau. Megan takes an adventure to Fferm Fach to see from where the water comes to her house.

programme.title: Shwshaswyn
programme.desc: The Autumn is a colourful time but it's good to concentrate on one marvel at a time. Today, the Captain has some acorns, whilst Fflwff is dancing with the leaves before Seren has the chance to put them in her scrapbook.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd, ac y tro hwn byddwn yn dod i nabod crwban y mor a gloyn y llaethlys. This time, we get to know the sea turtle and the milkweed butterfly.

programme.title: Bendibwmbwls
programme.desc: Heddiw bydd Ben Dant yn ymuno á disgyblion Ysgol Llanfair ym Muallt i greu trysor penigamp. Today, Ben Dant joins the pupils of Ysgol Llanfair ym Muallt to create a superb treasure.

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Anturiaethau dyn tân enwocaf Cymru. The adventures of Wales' most famous fireman.

programme.title: Amser Maith Maith Yn Ol
programme.desc: In Amser Maith Maith yn ôl' one of Llywelyn's most important people, Ednyfed Fychan, has arrived.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Het gynnes, het binc, het haul. 'Het' yw gair arbennig heddiw ac mae'r rhaglen yn llawn hetiau! 'Het' meaning 'hat' is the special word, and there are all sorts of hats - warm hats, pink hats, and sun hats.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Pan mae Mr Cadno yn dal Watcyn, mae'n rhaid i Guto ei achub cyn iddo gael ei droi'n bryd o fwyd. When Mr Cadno catches Watcyn, Guto has to save him from being turned into dinner.

programme.title: Jen A Jim Pob Dim
programme.desc: Mae defaid du a gwyn Fflur ar goll! Wedi tipyn o ymdrech gan Jen, Jim, Bolgi a Cyw, mae'r gorlan yn llawn anifeiliaid du a gwyn. Fflur's black and white sheep are missing.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ond pan mae mam yn chwilio am rhywbeth, mae o'n poeni ac mae'n rhaid i bawb ei helpu i ffeindio 'dim byd'! When mum is looking for something, everyone has to help Pablo find `nothing'!

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae'r gadwyn wedi torri ar feic Harri - lwcus mai i weithdy trwsio beics mae o'n mynd heddiw. The chain on Harri's bike has broken, but it is lucky that he is going to a bike repair workshop today.

programme.title: Caru Canu
programme.desc: Cân draddodiadol am antur Deryn y Bwn o Fannau Brycheiniog wrth iddo fynd ar ei wyliau. A Welsh song following the adventures of a Bitten Bird from the Brecon Beacons as he goes on holiday.

programme.title: Patrôl Pawennau
programme.desc: Mae Robo-gi yn mynd dros ben llestri tra'n trwsio teclynau drwy Porth yr Haul. Ryder entrusts the care of Adventure Bay to Robo-Dog while he and the Pups go on holiday, but this leads to problems when Robo-Dog tinkers with the Flounder.

programme.title: Oli Wyn
programme.desc: Heddiw, mae Lewis a Doug am ddangos lori graen wrth ei waith. Lewis and Doug show us a crane lorry at work.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Tydi Jetboi na Jetferch ddim yn cymryd hen jet eu rhieni o ddifri: nes i Peredur greu helynt gyda'i ddyfais clogyn newydd. Neither Jet-boy nor Jet-girl take their parents' old jet seriously!

programme.title: Deian a Loli
programme.desc: Tydi Deian heb fod mewn hwylia drwy'r dydd, a'r peth dwytha' mae o isho ei wneud ydi mynd i barti aduniad coleg Dad! After freezing their parents, the twins meet a new friend.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Yn y bennod hon, mae'r Olobobs yng nghaffi Dino - mae breuddwyd Dino i gael caffi ei hun wedi dod yn wir! In this episode, the Olobobs are at Dino's café.
